CONDITIONAL WAIVER AND RELEASE ON PROGRESS PAYMENT

Project: Kestrel Plant 3 Expansion, 1400 Foundry Road, Austin, Travis County, Texas
Job No.: 2026-0412
Owner: Kestrel Development Partners, LLC
Claimant: Tallow Ridge Components, LLC
Through Date: March 31, 2026

NOTICE:

This document waives the claimant's lien, payment bond, and other claim rights effective on receipt of payment. A person should not sign this document until the payment has been received. If the claimant has not been paid, use a conditional release form.

This document is enforceable only if the claimant receives a payment in the amount of $148,200.00. If the claimant has not been paid, this document is not effective to release, waive, or extinguish any lien, payment bond, or other claim right.

WAIVER AND RELEASE:

On receipt by the claimant of a check from Kestrel Development Partners, LLC in the sum of $148,200.00 payable to Tallow Ridge Components, LLC, and when the check has been properly endorsed and has been paid by the bank on which it is drawn, this document becomes effective to release any mechanic's lien right, any right arising from a payment bond that complies with a state or federal statute, any common law payment bond right, any claim for payment, and any rights under any similar ordinance, rule, or statute related to claim or payment rights for persons in the claimant's position that the claimant has on the property of Kestrel Development Partners, LLC located at 1400 Foundry Road, Austin, Travis County, Texas, to the following extent:

This release covers a progress payment for all labor, services, equipment, or materials furnished to the property or to Kestrel Development Partners, LLC as an owner or lessee of the property through March 31, 2026 only, and does not cover any retention, pending modifications and changes, or items furnished after that date. Before any recipient of this document relies on it, the party should verify evidence of payment to the claimant.

The claimant warrants that the claimant has already paid or will use the funds received from this progress payment to promptly pay in full all of the claimant's laborers, subcontractors, materialmen, and suppliers for all work, materials, equipment, or services provided for or to the above referenced project up to the date of this waiver.

RETAINAGE AND UNBILLED ITEMS EXCLUDED. This release does not cover retainage of $16,466.67 withheld to date, nor any change order or claim not included in the payment above.

Date: April 14, 2026

TALLOW RIDGE COMPONENTS, LLC
